start_url.description: Web entry URL for the product's breakdown request journey; confirm web is the intended surface.

failed_call_location.description: Seeded breakdown location producing at least two mechanic calls, one successful and one failed, with known successful result.

simulation_location.description: Seeded breakdown location and environment configuration that runs the mechanic calls in simulation mode.

unknown_quote_location.description: Seeded breakdown location with a mechanic call transcript that reports no quote.

multiple_offers_location.description: Seeded breakdown location yielding multiple overlapping mechanic calls and reported offers.

four_candidates_location.description: Seeded breakdown location with at least four potential mechanics for the three-result upper-bound case.

unknown_arrival_location.description: Seeded breakdown location with a mechanic call transcript that reports no arrival estimate.

unknown_availability_location.description: Seeded breakdown location with a mechanic call transcript that reports no availability.

unknown_conditions_location.description: Seeded breakdown location with a mechanic call transcript that reports no conditions.

eligible_accepted_location.description: Breakdown location with an eligible offer and controlled explicit business acceptance after authorization.

eligible_pending_location.description: Breakdown location with an eligible offer whose business acceptance can be held pending.

eligible_repeat_location.description: Breakdown location with an eligible offer allowing repeated confirmation attempts and attributable dispatch observation.

eligible_unauthed_location.description: Breakdown location with an eligible offer that can be selected without authorizing booking.

over_arrival_location.description: Breakdown location with an available-now offer whose known arrival exceeds the configured user maximum.

at_max_arrival_location.description: Breakdown location with an available-now offer whose known arrival equals the configured user maximum.

max_arrival_time.description: User maximum arrival time chosen to match the controlled offers, in the input's expected units.
